summary: Mobile & Tablet Optimization testing completed successfully. All 9 requested features tested and verified: Mobile bottom navigation (5 tabs), active state highlighting with cyan-400 color, mobile drawer slides from right on 'More' tap, drawer contains all 4 sections (Product Families, Technologies, Specifier Tools, Company), drawer closes via close button and backdrop, navigation via bottom nav tabs works correctly, bottom nav hidden on desktop (>=1024px), bottom nav visible on mobile/tablet (<1024px), desktop navigation still works correctly.

integration_issues.issue: After clicking a link in the mobile drawer (e.g., About Us), the drawer AnimatePresence exit animation may not complete before page navigation, causing drawer to appear briefly visible on new page. This is a minor visual race condition.

features_tested.feature: Mobile bottom navigation bar (5 tabs: Home, Products, Solutions, Contact, More)
features_tested.details: All 5 tabs present with correct icons (Home, Grid3X3, Layers, Phone, Menu) and labels. Visible at 393px and 768px viewports.

features_tested.feature: Bottom navigation tab highlighting and active state indicators
features_tested.details: Active tabs show cyan-400 color (rgb(34, 211, 238)) for both icon and text. Active indicator dot appears below icon. Verified on Home and Products pages.

features_tested.feature: Mobile drawer menu slides in from right when 'More' is tapped
features_tested.details: Drawer opens with spring animation (damping: 30, stiffness: 300) from right side. Width: 85% max-w-320px.

features_tested.feature: Mobile drawer contains Product Families, Technologies, Specifier Tools, Company sections
features_tested.details: All 4 sections found: PRODUCT FAMILIES (5 families), TECHNOLOGIES (5 links), SPECIFIER TOOLS (4 tools), COMPANY (7 links). WhatsApp CTA also present.

features_tested.feature: Drawer closes properly when clicking backdrop or close button
features_tested.details: Close button (X) works with force=True click. Backdrop click also closes drawer. AnimatePresence handles exit animation.

features_tested.feature: Navigation using bottom nav tabs works correctly (routes to correct pages)
features_tested.details: Home (/) -> Products (/products) -> Solutions (/solutions) -> Contact (/contact) all navigate correctly.

features_tested.feature: Bottom nav is hidden on desktop (>= 1024px)
features_tested.details: At 1024px (lg breakpoint) and 1200px, mobile bottom nav is correctly hidden via lg:hidden class.

features_tested.feature: Bottom nav is visible on mobile and tablet (< 1024px)
features_tested.details: Visible at 393px (mobile), 768px (tablet), and 1023px. All 5 tabs accessible.
Desktop nav shows PRODUCTS and SOLUTIONS dropdowns on hover. Product families (LUMIMORPH, NATURATEX, etc.) links visible. More menu dropdown works.

additional_tests.details: All 5 product families (LUMIMORPH, NATURATEX, SIGNATOUCH, GLASSMORPH, PIXELVUE) linked and navigating correctly.
COB Technology link navigates to /technology/cob correctly.
Screen Calculator link navigates to /calculator correctly.
WhatsApp button present with correct wa.me link.
Theme toggle button works, switches between dark/light mode. Drawer adapts styling to theme.

critical_code_review_comments: MobileBottomNav.js: Well-structured with proper data-testid attributes on all tabs. Uses framer-motion for tap animation. Active state correctly determined via useLocation().
MobileDrawer.js: Comprehensive menu with all sections. Uses AnimatePresence for smooth open/close animations. Proper backdrop click handling.
PublicLayout.js: Clean state management for drawer open/close. Correctly passes onMenuClick and onClose props.
App.css: Proper media query at 1024px (lg breakpoint) to hide mobile nav on desktop. Body padding-bottom for mobile prevents content being hidden behind nav.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile/Tablet navigation optimization testing complete. New MobileBottomNav (5 tabs) and MobileDrawer components working correctly. Bottom nav visible below 1024px, hidden at lg+ breakpoints. Desktop navigation unchanged. Minor note: drawer AnimatePresence exit may have slight race condition on link navigation but does not affect functionality.
